title: Framework Service and System Application Changes Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies framework service and system application changes?
options: Place authority in the owning service, validate Binder identity first, and prove boot, security, compatibility, persistence, and client-death behavior.
questions.answer: Place authority in the owning service, validate Binder identity first, and prove boot, security, compatibility, persistence, and client-death behavior.
questions.explanation: The correct response preserves authority, compatibility, exact artifact evidence, adverse-path behavior, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: A preinstalled system app can safely enforce a platform permission only in its local UI code.
questions.explanation: Calling clearCallingIdentity before authorization makes later checks run as the privileged service rather than the original app caller.

questions.prompt: Why validate before clearing Binder identity?
questions.answer: Authorization must evaluate the kernel-supplied original caller rather than the privileged system service identity.
questions.explanation: The answer identifies the contract or mechanism that remains valid beyond one implementation demonstration.
